name: {dist}_m_YELLOWGREEN_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA5: W8-SA5B 750 x 250 illustrated (A 600 x 200, C 900 x 300, D 1200 x 400; PNG W8-SA5A.png), fluorescent yellow-green, R50, 10 / 30. Distance numerals 140 E ('VARIES', dashed box; the line is centred as a whole, '=' margins on the sheet), 60 gap, m 120 E lower case (125 wide), baseline 195 (55 below). The sheet gives no example: generated at 100 to 500 m in hundreds — not confirmed against SA practice. To be installed with W6-SA1, W6-SA2 and W6-SA3 only.
